prompt: Get a snapshot from my IP camera located at rtsp://admin:pass@192.168.1.100:554/stream1 and save it as front_door.jpg
expected: Provide the exact ffmpeg command to capture a single frame from the RTSP stream.
actual: Use the following command to capture a snapshot from your RTSP stream: `ffmpeg -i "rtsp://admin:pass@192.168.1.100:554/stream1" -frames:v 1 front_door.jpg`

prompt: I need to set up Frigate to detect people and notify me via MQTT.
expected: Load `references/security-integration.md` and `references/processing.md` to explain how Frigate handles local YOLO models and sends MQTT events, providing a python snippet to subscribe to the events.
actual: I will check the references for Frigate integration. Frigate can run YOLO models locally. You can use Python to subscribe to the MQTT topic `frigate/events` and listen for `person` label events.

prompt: I want to do a focus stacking shot sequence with my Canon camera via USB.
expected: Load `references/photography-control.md` and explain how to use gphoto2 to set manual focus and capture a sequence.
actual: For focus stacking via USB, we can use `gphoto2`. First set the focus mode to manual: `gphoto2 --set-config /main/capturesettings/focusmode=Manual`. Then manually adjust focus between captures.
